title: Kissed Indulgent Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: This earthy and pillowy Algerian dish features tender lamb, rich cream, and the deep flavors of tandoor spices, all slow cooked to perfection in a traditional tagine, with a dash of friendly warmth in every bite.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add another tablespoon of oil to the pot, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the tandoor spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot, along with the heavy cream, chicken broth, chopped apricots, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake the tagine for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender and the sauce has thickened.
